API docs by Redocly

315 PLOTS API (1.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:Download

License: Proprietary

Backend for the 315 PLOTS mobile app.

Roles — USER (every customer; becomes a partner after admin approval) and ADMIN (operations, /admin/*).

Try it here

  1. POST /auth/otp/request with your mobile.
  2. POST /auth/otp/verify with the code (in staging the code is in the server logs).
  3. Click Authorize and paste accessToken.

Conventions

  • Money is integer paise: amountPaise: 2100000 = ₹21,000. Display ₹ = paise ÷ 100.
  • Lists take page (from 0) and size (1–50) and return { items, page, size, total }.
  • Every error is { code, message, requestId } — branch on code.
  • Access tokens last 15 minutes; refresh with POST /auth/refresh (one refresh at a time).
  • Dates are ISO-8601 UTC.

Auth

Sign in with mobile OTP or Google, refresh and revoke tokens.

Send login OTP

Sends a 6-digit OTP by SMS. The code is valid for 5 minutes. Limits: 3 requests per mobile per 15 minutes, 30 per IP per minute.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
mobile
required
string^[6-9]\d{9}$

10-digit Indian mobile number without +91, starting with 6–9

Responses

This server

/auth/otp/request

Staging (AWS Amplify)

https://main.doi0il8u9q02x.amplifyapp.com/auth/otp/request

Local development

http://localhost:3000/auth/otp/request

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "mobile": "9876543210"
}

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 429
Content type
application/json
{
  • "expiresInSec": 300,
  • "resendAfterSec": 30
}

Verify OTP and sign in

Checks the OTP and returns tokens. Creates the account on first login (optionally under a referral code). profileComplete: false means send the user to the profile screen before booking.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
mobile
required
string^[6-9]\d{9}$

Same mobile the OTP was requested for

code
required
string = 6 characters ^\d{6}$

6-digit code received by SMS (valid 5 minutes, 5 attempts)

referralCode
string <= 20 characters

Optional. Partner's referral code; applied only when this creates a new account

leg
string
Enum: "L" "R"

Optional. Side of the sponsor's team (L or R). Omit to auto-balance

deviceId
string <= 200 characters

Optional. Device identifier, stored with the refresh token

Responses

This server

/auth/otp/verify

Staging (AWS Amplify)

https://main.doi0il8u9q02x.amplifyapp.com/auth/otp/verify

Local development

http://localhost:3000/auth/otp/verify

Refresh tokens

Exchanges a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair; the old refresh token stops working. Run one refresh at a time: reusing an old refresh token signs the user out on every device.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
refreshToken
required
string

Refresh token from the last login or refresh

Responses

Bookings

Hold a plot and pay through Razorpay.

Book a plot (start checkout)

Holds the plot for 15 minutes and creates a Razorpay order. Open Razorpay Checkout with razorpayKeyId, razorpayOrderId and amountPaise, then call POST /payments/verify. The booking becomes CONFIRMED only after the server verifies the payment.

Authorizations:
bearer
Request Body schema: application/json
required
plotId
required
string

Plot to book (from GET /plots, must be AVAILABLE)

tierId
required
string

Booking plan (from GET /tiers)

termsAccepted
required
boolean

Must be true: the customer accepted the booking terms

Responses

This server

/bookings

Webhooks

Server-to-server callbacks from Razorpay and Cashfree. Not for the app.

Razorpay webhook (server-to-server)

Called by Razorpay, never by the app. Body is the raw Razorpay event; the X-Razorpay-Signature header must be the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret. Handles payment.captured, payment.failed, refund.processed. Repeated events are accepted and ignored.

header Parameters
x-razorpay-signature
required
string
x-razorpay-event-id
required
string
Request Body schema: application/json
required
object
